teaser: Keys already in the door before the sentence is finished — that's often how a 1 who is also an ENTP leaves a room, mid-argument, already certain of the next move. Life path 1 asks for self-reliance, a will that doesn't wait for permission. ENTP brings a mind that argues both sides of everything, including its own plans, just to see what breaks. Cross the two and you get someone who starts things fast, defends them loudly, and sometimes abandons them just as fast when a better idea elbows in. Determination and restlessness share the same desk here, and it isn't the number or the type alone that explains why an idea can be built and dismantled before dinner.
